svg.text: MiNTs-CPU architecture: DE0-CV FPGA board SoC
Cyclone V 5CEBA4F23C7, 20 MHz: the shared CPU RTL plus board-specific additions and replacements (SDRAM, JTAG loader, UART PHY, VGA, microSD)
CPU core: in-order 5-stage pipeline, RV64IMAC, M/S/U privilege
store buffer + AMO idle before re-fetch
fetch memory port: I-cache refill + I-side PTE reads
M-mode bypass; access fault on PMP violation
rv64 ui / um / ua / uc / mi / si
write, read-back verify, then release CPU
Same CPU RTL as the simulator. The board adds the PLL, SDRAM path, JTAG loader,
UART PHY, VGA and microSD, and replaces the RAM model, the DPI UART backend
and the 0x4000_0000 window. Fit 17,269 / 18,480 ALM (93 %); timing passes at 20 MHz.
Conceptual block diagram: buses, handshakes and arbitration are simplified.
